name: Video Agent
intro: Video Agent turns a plain description into a motion graphics animation. You preview it live, tune it by chatting, and render it to an MP4.

features.describe-your-animation: Start by describing the animation you want in the box, then press Enter. It's the fastest way to a first draft with no code.
features.model-picker: The model picker next to the input sets how much the AI thinks before it builds. Choose a higher level for complex animations.
features.attach-reference-images: The paperclip button attaches reference images, or you can paste or drop them in, to show a layout, palette or style you want.
features.follow-up-chat-tune-your-animation: After the first draft, the chat sidebar lets you ask for changes. Iterating this way is faster than starting over.
features.use-current-frame-as-image: This button grabs the frame showing in the preview and attaches it to your message, so you can point at exactly what needs fixing.
features.settings-duration-and-fps: The Settings button lets you set the duration and frame rate, and shows the resulting video length before you render.
features.render-and-download: Render and Download creates the MP4 right in your browser, and a finished render is saved to your library automatically.

outro: That's Video Agent. Describe it, tune it, and render it, all without touching a line of animation code.
